title: Cylex city and trade inputs
description: Configure controlled city/trade research. Dry run is on by default.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Plan jobs without contacting directory sites.

locations.title: Cities and states
locations.description: One city per line: City, ST (e.g. Houston, TX). For statewide work, provide many city lines.

trades.title: Contractor trades
trades.description: Trade names to combine with each city. Supported: electrical, plumbing, hvac, roofing, drywall, concrete, general contractor.

maxListings.title: Total maximum listings
maxListings.description: Maximum output companies in a run.

maxListingsPerJob.title: Maximum listings per city and trade
maxListingsPerJob.description: Output limit for each city and trade combination.

maxPagesPerJob.title: Maximum category pages per job
maxPagesPerJob.description: Directory category page limit per city and trade combination.

maxRequests.title: Maximum HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Hard count cap, including robots.txt fetches.

minDelayMs.title: Minimum delay between requests
minDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between each request.

extractEmails.title: Extract directory emails
extractEmails.description: Read publicly displayed mailto contact addresses on Cylex profile pages.

maxEstimatedUsd.title: Estimated request budget USD
maxEstimatedUsd.description: Approximate internal cost stop, not an Apify billing limit.

estimatedUsdPerRequest.title: Assumed USD per request
estimatedUsdPerRequest.description: Cost assumption only. Actual compute and proxies are separate.

proxyMode.title: Apify proxy mode
proxyMode.description: DATACENTER uses available Apify datacenter proxies. OFF uses direct requests. Residential proxies are never enabled.
